executive_summary: Larkspur Logistics takes an average of 11 days to turn an accepted quote into cash. Operations staff re-key shipment charges between the transport management system (TMS) and the accounting package, which slows invoicing, creates disputes and leaves finance without a trustworthy view of margin.

Northfield Advisory Partners proposes a 16-week programme to diagnose the current process, design a target state, build the TMS-to-accounting integration, pilot it at one depot and, in the recommended option, roll it out to two further depots. The goal is to bring quote-to-cash below 5 days before the 2027 peak season.
executive_bullets: Outcome: quote-to-cash under 5 days, measured on pilot-depot data (client target).
One source of truth for shipment charges, with an audit trail for every change.
Three options priced from USD 38,000 to USD 126,000; we recommend Better.

paras: From our discovery call on 18 November we understand the following. These points are the client's account of the situation and will be tested in the diagnosis phase.
needs: Quotes accepted today are invoiced on average 6 days later; cash arrives after a further 5.
Charges are re-keyed by hand, so rate and surcharge errors surface as customer disputes.
Finance cannot reconcile shipment margin without exporting and merging spreadsheets.
Changes must be live at the pilot depot before the 2027 peak season begins.

approach.intro: We work in four phases. Each phase ends with a milestone review at which the client accepts the deliverables before the next phase starts.

phases.name: Diagnose
phases.description: Map the current quote-to-cash flow, measure cycle time per step and quantify the cost of rework.

phases.name: Design
phases.description: Define the target process, data model and controls, and agree the integration specification.

phases.name: Build and pilot
phases.description: Build the integration, test with real shipments and run a live pilot at one depot.

phases.name: Roll out
phases.description: Extend to two further depots, train teams and hand over to client owners. Best option adds 90 days of hypercare.

deliverables: Current-state process map and baseline metrics
Annotated end-to-end map; cycle time and rework baseline
Field mapping, error handling, reconciliation rules
Tested build deployed to pilot depot
Cycle time vs baseline, defects, lessons
Two further depots live; trained staff; playbooks
Named support, weekly metrics review, fixes
assumptions: Larkspur provides access to TMS and accounting administrators within five working days of kick-off.
Both systems expose supported APIs or file imports; if not, a change request will be raised.
The client nominates one accountable business owner with authority to approve deliverables within five working days.
Pilot depot staff are available for up to four hours per week during design and pilot.
Third-party licence or vendor fees for either system are excluded.
Work is performed remotely with up to three on-site visits per depot; travel is billed at cost.

rows: Live pilot at one depot and results report (D5)
Rollout to two further depots and training (D6)

pricing.notes: Prices are in USD and valid until 31 January 2027.
